meta.title: Pick a random open material line that can be sourced

plan.title: Select an Eligible Open PR Material Line

steps.note: Open the Purchase Requisitions area from the buyer console.
Ensure the search is limited to open requisitions.

args.goal: find a random open material line, open its purchase requisition, verify that Qty Open equals Qty Requested and that the line has no lock or hold icon and is not under approval, then record the PR number, line number, and item; stop on the line details showing this evidence

steps.note: Inspect and document the line-level eligibility details that have no dedicated catalog assertion step.
Confirm the resulting PR screen has no rendering errors or raw failure content.
